[EN]
After the incident in the Broken Prison, the Valkyon Federation has sent reinforcements to defend Northern Arun.

It seems that while we were focusing our attention elsewhere, Velika began experiencing earthquakes.
The Mysterium Scholars inform us that this is not a natural occurrence.

We need someone to find the cause of these earthquakes—someone brave and competent.
Naturally, I thought of you, .

There is no time to waste.
The citizens are growing more and more panicked every day.

[You must have equipment level 453 or higher to enter Velik’s Hold.]
[ES]
Tras el incidente en la Broken Prison, la Valkyon Federation ha enviado refuerzos para defender Northern Arun.

Parece que mientras concentrábamos nuestra atención en otra parte, Velika comenzó a experimentar terremotos.
Los eruditos del Mysterium nos informan que esto no es un acontecimiento natural.

Necesitamos a alguien que encuentre la causa de estos terremotos, alguien valiente y competente.
Naturalmente, pensé en ti,
.

No hay tiempo que perder.
Los ciudadanos entran en pánico cada vez más todos los días.

[Debes tener un nivel de equipo de 453 o superior para entrar a Velik’s Hold.]

[EN] Seir asks to investigate the sudden earthquake in Velika. Upon arriving in a secret, underground complex, faces an endless group of monsters demolishing the area, and the source of all evil himself, the god Lakan.
[ES] Seir le pide a que investigue el repentino terremoto en Velika. Al llegar a un complejo subterráneo secreto, se enfrenta a un grupo interminable de monstruos que destrozan la zona y a la fuente de todo mal en persona, el dios Lakan.

[EN] Good to see you, .
You've arrived at the perfect time.

Recently, the area around Velika has experienced strange earthquakes. At first it seemed to be affecting just the area around the Dock, but now we're getting reports that people in Velika Plaza have felt tremors as well.
Something is happening under the city... and we need your help investigating it.

Go to Velik's Steps, and you'll find a secret passage leading to a network of passages under the city.Secret passage... interesting.
[ES] Qué bueno verte, .
Has llegado en el momento perfecto.

Recientemente, la zona alrededor de Velika ha experimentado extraños terremotos. Al principio parecía afectar solo al área alrededor del Dock, pero ahora recibimos informes de que la gente en Velika Plaza también ha sentido temblores.
Algo está pasando bajo la ciudad... y necesitamos tu ayuda para investigarlo.

Ve a Velik's Steps y encontrarás un pasaje secreto que lleva a una red de pasajes bajo la ciudad.Secret passage... interesting.

[EN] The gate that leads to Velika's underground is normally a closely-guarded secret, but the situation is urgent.

Please hurry, . Time is running out.
